GOLD_2024.title: Global Strategy for the Diagnosis, Management, and Prevention of Chronic Obstructive Lung Disease (2024 Report)
GOLD_2024.authors: Global Initiative for Chronic Obstructive Lung Disease
GOLD_2024.abstract: The GOLD 2024 Report provides evidence-based recommendations for COPD diagnosis, classification into Groups A, B, and E, pharmacotherapy with LABA, LAMA, ICS based on eosinophil counts, target oxygen saturation of 88-92% in exacerbation, systemic corticosteroids (prednisolone 40mg daily for 5 days), antibiotic criteria (Anthonisen), and long-term home oxygen/NIV therapy.
